body.ruleText:
rule dac_gcp_0018 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GCP: Secret Manager AccessSecretVersion burst - AccessSecretVersion high volume"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GCP-0018"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1555.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /AccessSecretVersion$/ nocase
    $email = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $email over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e and $count > 20
}
